SELECT event_uid
FROM (
    SELECT
        event_uid,
        src_ip,
        dst_ip,
        time,
        bytes_out,
        bytes_in,
        AVG(time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip ORDER BY time)) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip) AS avg_interval,
        STDDEV(time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip ORDER BY time)) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip) AS stddev_interval,
        MAX(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip) - MIN(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip) AS span,
        AVG(bytes_out + bytes_in) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip) AS avg_bytes,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip) AS cnt
    FROM f_network
)
WHERE
    avg_interval BETWEEN 45 AND 75
    AND (stddev_interval IS NULL OR stddev_interval < 20)
    AND span >= 3000
    AND avg_bytes < 5000
    AND cnt >= 10

WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        event_uid,
        src_ip,
        dst_ip,
        time,
        bytes_out,
        bytes_in,
        LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip ORDER BY time) AS prev_time
    FROM f_network
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT
        src_ip,
        dst_ip,
        event_uid,
        bytes_out,
        bytes_in,
        time,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - prev_time)) AS gap_seconds
    FROM ordered
    WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
),
pair_stats AS (
    SELECT
        src_ip,
        dst_ip,
        COUNT(*) AS conn_count,
        AVG(gap_seconds) AS avg_gap,
        STDDEV(gap_seconds) AS stddev_gap,
        AVG(bytes_out + bytes_in) AS avg_bytes,
        MAX(time) - MIN(time) AS session_span
    FROM intervals
    GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip
),
beacon_pairs AS (
    SELECT src_ip, dst_ip
    FROM pair_stats
    WHERE avg_gap BETWEEN 45 AND 75
      AND stddev_gap < 15
      AND avg_bytes < 5000
      AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM session_span) >= 3000
      AND conn_count >= 10
)

WITH all_user_uids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_uid AS id, 'user_uid' AS id_type FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT user_uid, 'user_uid' FROM f_session WHERE user_uid IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT actor_user_uid, 'actor_user_uid' FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT actor_user_uid, 'actor_user_uid' FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid IS NOT NULL
),
all_ips AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT src_ip AS id, 'src_ip' AS id_type FROM f_auth WHERE src_ip IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT src_ip, 'src_ip' FROM f_network WHERE src_ip IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT src_ip, 'src_ip' FROM f_dns WHERE src_ip IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT src_ip, 'src_ip' FROM f_api WHERE src_ip IS NOT NULL
),
all_hostnames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT target_host AS id, 'target_host' AS id_type FROM f_auth WHERE target_host IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT host, 'session_host' FROM f_session WHERE host IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT src_hostname, 'src_hostname' FROM f_network WHERE src_hostname IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT src_hostname, 'src_hostname' FROM f_dns WHERE src_hostname IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, 'device_hostname' FROM f_process WHERE device_hostname IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT hostname, 'asset_hostname' FROM f_asset WHERE hostname IS NOT NULL
),
all_asset_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ip AS id, 'asset_ip' AS id_type FROM f_asset WHERE ip IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT instance_uid, 'instance_uid' FROM f_asset WHERE instance_uid IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT canonical_asset, 'canonical_asset' FROM f_asset WHERE canonical_asset IS NOT NULL
),
actor_anchor AS (
    SELECT id, id_type FROM all_user_uids
    UNION
    SELECT id, id_type FROM all_ips
    UNION
    SELECT id, id_type FROM all_hostnames
    UNION
    SELECT id, id_type FROM all_asset_ids
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.id,
    a.id_type
FROM actor_anchor a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT src_ip FROM f_auth WHERE src_ip IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT src_ip FROM f_session s JOIN f_auth fa ON s.user_uid = fa.user_uid WHERE src_ip IS NOT NULL
) linked_ips ON (a.id_type IN ('src_ip','asset_ip') AND a.id = linked_ips.src_ip)
OR a.id_type IN ('user_uid','actor_user_uid')
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM f_asset ast
    WHERE (a.id_type = 'asset_hostname' AND ast.hostname = a.id)
       OR (a.id_type = 'asset_ip'       AND ast.ip       = a.id)
       OR (a.id_type = 'instance_uid'   AND ast.instance_uid = a.id)
       OR (a.id_type = 'canonical_asset'AND ast.canonical_asset = a.id)
)
